# SUI-21 — Processing Load defaults to OFF across all plugins

**Tracking issue:** https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/291
**Origin:** Generated by Matrix from the tracking issue when the card was picked up, because no prompt file existed and the issue had enough detail. The issue text below is the specification.

## Objective
Make the **Processing Load** diagnostic display **OFF by default** in every Songsmith plugin/module (EQ, Analog Compressor, Maximiser, standalone Compressor, and other current or future modules that expose the control).

## Required behaviour
- On first launch / when no prior user preference exists, **Processing Load is OFF** (readout hidden/collapsed).
- Keep the Processing Load button accessible so users can switch diagnostics ON when needed; ON must show the existing CPU and latency information accurately.
- Define preference persistence explicitly: a user's intentional ON/OFF selection may be remembered, but default settings, resets, and newly instantiated modules without a stored preference must start OFF. Do not accidentally turn it on via test harnesses.
- Apply the same default across VST3/AU/standalone formats where supported and all module editors.
- Avoid changing audio DSP, latency reporting, or plugin project/preset compatibility.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Fresh settings: Processing Load is OFF on every plugin.
2. Turning it ON displays CPU/latency; turning it OFF hides them, without layout regression.
3. Saved preference (if implemented) behaves consistently across reopen and multiple instances; default remains OFF when absent.
4. Tests cover clean settings, old settings/migration, editor reopen, multiple plugin types, and accidental preference mutation.
5. Relevant plugin GUI/build tests pass; screenshots demonstrate default OFF.

## Context
- [SUI-12 implementation / overnight run #86](https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/86) documented the shared footer and an earlier test-harness issue that mistakenly left Processing Load enabled in Diagnostics.xml.
- Should cover the recently added standalone Compressor as well.

## Delivery
Use suite-wide shared defaults rather than repeated plugin-specific hacks. Follow repository version increment, PR/CI/merge and R2/beta website verification procedure. Close only after successful publication and evidence comment.

**Backlog only — do not immediately queue or start Matrix work.**
